checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man
must.why: Same face, hair, shirt and kitchen across all frames.

must.item: Audible, coherent English line inviting viewers to check out the sale
must.why: Audio has sound at -0.4 dB peak. The transcript says the line is 'Our sale is on now. Come check it out!', but I can't hear it.

must.item: No invented discount, date, product or offer claim
must.why: The stated script has none, but the spoken audio wasn't verified.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: The mouth is open and moving at 0.5 s and 2 s, and closed with a smile at the end. Exact sync can't be verified without audio.

must.item: One square, 8-second video with friendly male voice and no captions
must.why: The clip is square with no captions, but it is 5 s, not 8 s. The voice can't be judged.

faults.what: The clip is 5 s, not the 8 s the item expects, because of the plan limit. The agent explained this to the user.

summary: A clean 5-second square talking clip of the same grey-haired man with natural mouth movement and no artefacts. It is shorter than the 8 s expected, and the audio couldn't be checked.
